answer: The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, released only after three unrelated confirmations, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. The tide holds work receipts rather than names, so the sable of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the tundra of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
